environment.server: Temporary HTTP server bound only to 127.0.0.1
environment.wordPressApi: Local fixtures emulate exercise, project, group and submission responses
environment.editor: Local iframe fixture emulates MakeCode workspacesync, workspacesave and saveproject acknowledgements

checks: Problem list -> explanation -> editor -> submit -> submission history
Public sensor inputs are visible and hidden scenario names are absent
Iframe protocol captures the latest edited source before saving and submitting
Temporary project saving creates no submission; submitting creates one recorded result
Cancelling unsaved navigation preserves the current editor, source and URL
Reloading history and browser Back restore the appropriate deep-linked view
Group selector uses bounded cursor pages and retains selections without remapping lesson IDs
A 390px viewport has no document-level horizontal overflow
screenshotScope: Local synthetic student problem. Product CSS is loaded with minimal fixture styling; production OJ Platform shell and theme styling are not reproduced.
limitations: This verifies browser workflow and the iframe protocol boundary with controlled fixtures. It does not certify actual MakeCode, WordPress authentication, group membership, database plans, real grading, USB or operational server acceptance.
